data.desc: National Bankshares, Inc. , headquartered in Blacksburg, Virginia , is the parent company of The National Bank of Blacksburg , which does business as National Bank , and of National Bankshares Financial Services, Inc. National Bank is a community bank operating from 27 full-service offices in southwest and central Virginia , and two loan production offices in Roanoke and Charlottesville, Virginia. National Bankshares Financial Services, Inc. is an investment and insurance subsidiary in the same trade area.
